name: repo-research
description: Minimal deterministic autoresearch board for a local repository.

artifacts.name: repo_index
artifacts.description: Repository file inventory and quick context.

artifacts.name: planner_brief
artifacts.description: Planner brief describing the research objective.

artifacts.name: evidence
artifacts.description: Structured evidence extracted from the repository.

tasks.goal: Create a compact repository index for downstream agent tasks.
Draft a concise autoresearch plan grounded in the repository index.
tasks.prompt:
You are the planning worker for {{board_name}}. Goal: {{goal}}.

Use the following repository context:

{{inputs}}

Produce a short markdown brief with sections `Objective`, `Observations`, and `Next Steps`.
The brief must mention `Deterministic Execution`, `Artifacts`, and `Observability`.
Write only the markdown for the brief.

tasks.goal: Convert the planner brief and repo index into structured evidence.
Turn the evidence into a GitHub-friendly report.
tasks.prompt:
You are the synthesis worker for {{board_name}}. Goal: {{goal}}.

Inputs:
{{inputs}}

Produce a markdown report with sections `Summary`, `Signals`, `Recommended Product Positioning`, and `Why This Is Different`.
The report must include the exact phrases `Deterministic Execution`, `Artifacts`, and `Observability`.
Write only the final markdown report.

tasks.goal: Ensure the final report contains the required product signals.
